correctness.rationale: The source Hamiltonian is Hermitian; antisymmetric |m> decouples at -2J and the shifted symmetric block B is an irreducible 3x3 Jacobi matrix when Omega,D>0. Each spectral eigenvector has nonzero |p> component. Perfect transfer |00>→|11> is therefore equivalent to e^{-it beta_j}=-1 for every one of three distinct real eigenvalues. det B=-16JD^2<0, tr B=8J>0 imply exactly one negative root. Equating the full cubic characteristic coefficients yields S1=8J/a, S3=-16JD^2/a^3, Omega^2=a^2 Q with Q=(S1^3-4 S1 S2+8S3)/(16S1), so the stated odd-triple positivity and inverse construction are necessary and sufficient; no spectral-phase branch omitted. Countability proves planar nullity; approximating each real Jacobi eigenvalue by a nearby odd integer on scale k and using continuity at S1,Q>0 proves density of the reconstructed positive (J,D). A zero eigenmode with nonzero |p> projection excludes J=0,D>0. Independently constructed scipy expm for (-1,1,3) gives |<11|U|00>|²=0.9999999999999998 and leakage 3e-16, confirming the witness but not proving density.
